description: This file defines the interface DistributedDataConfig, which provides configuration settings for DistributedData, including timeout durations and the Akka replicator configuration. It also includes an internal enum DistributedDataConfigValue that implements KnownConfigValue and encapsulates default configuration path expressions and values related to distributed data replication.

classes.name: DistributedDataConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration settings for DistributedData, including methods to get read/write timeouts and Akka replicator configuration.

classes.name: DistributedDataConfig.DistributedDataConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, defining configuration path keys and default values for distributed data timeout settings.

methods.name: getReadTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for GET messages of the replicator.

methods.name: getWriteTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for UPDATE messages of the replicator.

methods.name: getAkkaReplicatorConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration used to create the Akka replicator.
